name: Tabs
headline: One subject. One phrase. No mercy.
idea: A daily phrase puzzle with poker mechanics. Pick a category, solve the hidden phrase, and stake your lives tile by tile.

points.title: A new daily
points.body: One puzzle every day, plus unlimited free play.

points.title: Four lives
points.body: Four lives for an entire phrase. A staked tile that misses costs one.

points.title: All in
points.body: An all-in shove ends the round one way or the other.
